description: Distinguish the approved Gram-matrix pseudoinverse threshold from a larger language-specific default threshold.

oracle.description: For the 2-by-2 Gram matrix, Biosigmat binary64 singular values are approximately 10.0000005 and 5.0165e-15. The approved tolerance is 2 * eps(10.0000005) = 3.5527e-15, so the second value is retained. A 1e-15 relative default threshold discards it and changes both components by more than the 1e-10 conformance tolerance. Expected outputs were generated with the equivalent explicit MATLAB pinv(G, tol) rule.
